Helper method to write to table <PIT_TABLE_PARAMS>.  Is used to wrap the insert operation on <PIT_TABLE_PARAMS>, used by several methods

Parameters
p_id
in pit_table_params.ptp_id%type

ID of the entry, taken from PIT_CALL_STACK_TYPE or <PIT_LOG_STATE_TYPE>

p_pse_id
in pit_table_params.ptp_pse_id%type

Severity of the entry. 70 if CALL_STACK entry

p_params
in msg_params

Instance of MSG_PARAMS

p_log_date
in timestamp

Parent message timestamp; defaults to current time for trace/state entries

persist_affected_ids
procedure persist_affected_ids(
p_message 
in message_type
)

Store object references separately from trace/state parameters.  The first non-null value for each name wins; unnamed/null entries are ignored.  Normal PIT messages, call stacks and states use distinct PIT_LOG_SEQ IDs.
